_readme: Dedupe plan for tl-target-set-focus/eduardos-annotated-photos, audited 2026-07-19. Executed by rebalance/dedupe_eduardos.py (dry-run by default). Keeper policy: the polygon-annotated copy first (tight hand-drawn 'orig'), tie-broken by smallest mean normalized bbox area. To override a choice, swap ids between 'keeper' and 'delete' in that group before running. pHashes are 64-bit DCT hashes recomputed by the script from the hosted originals before any deletion (mismatch => image skipped). Groups flagged 'label_conflict' continue the 2026-07-10 REVIEW backlog: copies carry different real defect labels, so the script deletes them only after the keeper's live annotation covers 'defects_missing_from_keeper' (merge the boxes onto the keeper in the Roboflow UI first), or set 'accept_keeper_as_is': true to override.
